Average of the minute's samples (about every 15 s), bytes. `null` when not reported for this period.

get.description:
The latest values plus a per-minute series for a time range: CPU, memory, disk and network. The range defaults to the last 60 minutes of the sandbox's life (up to now, or to its end) and spans at most 24 h; the series has one point per 60 s, is empty where nothing is stored, and is kept 30 days.

CPU, network and disk are measured on the host, outside the sandbox; disk is the bytes used on `/data`, the sandbox's disk, refreshed every one to two minutes, and doesn't include the root filesystem. Memory is reported from inside the sandbox. Memory and disk are for display only. GPU usage isn't reported yet: `gpus` is always `null`. A sandbox's last few seconds, and a sandbox that lives less than about 15 s, may not be measured.

parameters.description: Start of the range (RFC 3339, with a UTC offset). Default: 60 minutes before `to`, clipped to the sandbox's lifetime.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: End of the range (RFC 3339, with a UTC offset). Default: now, or the sandbox's end if it has ended.
parameters.name: to

400.description: Validation error: the standard Telnyx validation errors (codes such as 10004 missing parameter, 10015 bad request, 10025 invalid string length, 10026 invalid type).

errors.detail: Could not find any usable credentials in the request.

- `sandboxes_not_whitelisted`: Sandboxes isn't enabled for your organization (invite-only preview); `GET /ai/sandbox-access` tells whether it is.

404.description: Not found (code 10005): the resource doesn't exist or belongs to another organization. The detail says what's missing.

errors.detail: A dependency can't answer right now; retry later.
errors.title: Service unavailable

503.description: A dependency can't answer right now (code 10037); retry later.
